description: Merges db-migrate into release-notes, keeping both skills' triggers, exceptions and script, with more than 10% fewer loaded skill tokens and the same outcomes on every case.

.claude/skills/release-notes/scripts/che.content:
#!/bin/sh
# List migration files that are not recorded in db/applied.txt.
for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do
  name=$(basename "$f")
  grep -qx "$name" db/applied.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "pending: $name"
done

patch..claude/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:
---
name: release-notes
description: Draft release notes from merged changes, and plan and check database schema migrations. Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry, or to add, review or run a migration.
---
# Release notes

1. Run [the collector](scripts/collect.sh) to list merged changes since the last tag.
2. Print the collector summary line "Collected N changes" before the notes.
3. Group entries under Added, Changed and Fixed.
4. For a migration, run `scripts/check_migrations.sh` and explain each pending one before running anything.

Never include internal ticket ids such as INT-1234 in public release notes.
Do not run migrations against production unless the user names the change ticket.
